title: Lawn sprinkler
prompt: A labelled teaching model of the page 47 oscillating lawn sprinkler stands in a catch tray. Water opens an external supply so incoming water spins the turbine and then exits the spray tube. Two worm reductions turn a slow crank that swings the tube to and fro. Slow view slows only the explanatory animation to reveal the coupled turbine, worms and crank. Stop closes the external supply and the drive stops. See-through follows the same water path and mechanical train. Keep the supply valve and tray as teaching fixtures. Do not add arc adjustment, an electric motor or self-powered recirculation.
blurb: A teaching adaptation shows incoming water driving two worm reductions and a crank that swings an oscillating sprinkler.
